purpose: Define the SEIS Prompt Engine prompt-pack contract for browser-local demos, repository review prompts, security review prompts, and future backend-only provider routing without executing prompts or reading credentials.
truthBoundary: Static repository contract only. This schema validates prompt-pack metadata; it does not execute prompts, call providers, validate credentials, read private archives, or promote historical prompts automatically.

fieldDefinitions.title: Human-readable prompt pack name.
fieldDefinitions.ownerArea: Owning SEIS module or governance lane.
fieldDefinitions.intendedCapability: Specific task family this prompt pack supports.
fieldDefinitions.allowedContext: Repository-safe context classes that may be provided to the pack.
fieldDefinitions.deniedContext: Context classes that must never be included.
fieldDefinitions.providerCapabilityRequirements: Capability profile the future model router must satisfy before live use.
fieldDefinitions.outputSchema: Required response shape or artifact shape.
fieldDefinitions.evaluationFixture: Static fixture used for no-provider validation.
fieldDefinitions.rollbackNote: How to disable or revert the pack safely.
fieldDefinitions.allowedActions: Actions an assistant may perform under this pack.
fieldDefinitions.forbiddenActions: Actions the pack must never authorize.
fieldDefinitions.safetyBoundaries: No-secrets, local-only, review, clean-room, and escalation boundaries.
fieldDefinitions.validationMethod: Static or future runtime validation method.
fieldDefinitions.reviewState: Current review state: reviewed-fixture, draft, blocked, or retired.
fieldDefinitions.executionPolicy: Whether prompt execution, provider calls, credential reads, and archive promotion are allowed. Current fixtures must keep all false.

publicSafetyInvariants: Prompt packs must not contain API keys, private keys, real tokens, cookies, or private host credentials.
Prompt packs must not copy proprietary or leaked system prompts.
Prompt packs must mark demo, local-only, blocked, planned, and approval-needed states explicitly.
Prompt packs must not claim prompt engineering, retrieval, routing, or fixtures are model training.
Prompt packs must not enable browser-side live provider calls.
Prompt packs must be reversible through a documented rollback note.
